hero.kicker: Tender opportunities for South African businesses
hero.headline: Stop searching blindly. Start pursuing tenders that fit.
hero.body: TenderIQ is designed to help businesses find relevant tender opportunities, understand what each one requires, and decide which tenders are worth pursuing.

problem.title: Tendering takes more time than it should
problem.intro: Hours can disappear into a tender document before you find a requirement you can’t meet.
problem.items:
Suitable opportunities are found too late to respond properly
Long documents have to be reviewed manually, one by one
Mandatory requirements are easy to miss in the detail
Missing documents surface days before the deadline
Submissions are prepared under unnecessary time pressure
Opportunities outside your usual province go unnoticed
Time goes into screening instead of preparing a stronger bid

outcomes.title: What TenderIQ is designed to help you do

items.body: Focus on tenders closer to your capabilities, business profile and eligibility.

items.title: Screen opportunities earlier
items.body: Identify key qualification requirements before committing time to a full submission.

items.title: Understand what is required
items.body: See the relevant requirements in a structured, readable format.

items.title: Identify what is missing
items.body: Compare what a tender asks for with the documents and capabilities you have.

items.title: Prepare with more time
items.body: Find suitable opportunities early enough to plan the work without a last-minute rush.

items.title: Spend less time screening

items.title: Focus on stronger submissions

example.title: A tender in another province
example.disclaimer: An illustrative scenario — not a customer story, and not a guarantee of results.
example.steps:
A Gauteng electrical contractor usually only looks at tenders close to home.
An opportunity in Limpopo matches their services and capacity — one they would normally have missed.
They check the mandatory requirements early and see that two compliance documents need updating.
With weeks rather than days to spare, they update the documents and plan the logistics of working out of province.
They decide to bid, then prepare and submit through the issuer’s official process — without a last-minute rush.

trust.title: What TenderIQ does — and doesn’t — do
trust.items:
TenderIQ supports finding and assessing opportunities. It does not replace the issuer’s official tender documents.
You remain responsible for checking every requirement in the official documentation and submitting through the prescribed channel.
TenderIQ cannot guarantee that you will qualify for, or be awarded, any tender, or that every available tender will be found.

faqs.q: Does TenderIQ guarantee that I’ll win a tender?
faqs.a: No. TenderIQ is designed to help you find and assess opportunities. Whether you qualify and win depends on the tender, your submission and the issuer’s evaluation.

faqs.q: Does TenderIQ replace the official tender documents?
faqs.a: No. Always read the issuer’s official documents. Requirements vary from tender to tender, and the official documents take precedence.

faqs.q: How do I know if my business qualifies for a tender?
faqs.a: Check the mandatory requirements in the official tender documents. These often include registration and compliance documents, and sometimes an industry grading, but they differ for every tender. TenderIQ is designed to help you spot these requirements earlier.
